statement: MixedStepNeg (mixed slack |F2Mix|-baseDQ has a 1- or 0-step with no larger slack at every negative state of a MinCE) is stated as a Prop; MixedStepNeg implies no_minCE, proved.

The mixed step at negative states is the count: for one gate list, a non-increasing 0- or 1-step at every negative mixed state iff mslack >= 0 at every mixed state; so MixedStepNeg iff every MinCE has mslack >= 0 at all mixed states; and the abstract descent hypothesis of no_minCE_of_mixed_descent iff 0 <= slack(empty).

S3(a) per-set flip lemma, any number of NOT gates: for a correct SearchCheck.Circ, a set S with output o and a zero point Z of S, |S| <= (flip classes with |D|>=2 at (S,Z), wire functions up to complement) + 1; abstract graph argument Core.core.
